comments: This place is more like an "entire home" than a private room. It's large and you get your own bathroom/shower!!!!! It's clean, in a great location, and Erica is totally cool. I'd definitely stay here again.
A nice homey place in the perfect Village location.  Evelyn is a wonderful and attentive host.  Highly recommended!

We had a great stay at the apartment in New York. Everything was as described. And at our arrival Ivan gave us some good tips. Lower east side is a really nice part of New York and there is a lot to do. I would recommend this apartment to everyone.

Jon Snow was a fantastic host. He stayed in good communication  with me and met me on  my arrival. His place was great and had lots of cool stuff! Very friendly and welcoming. Great spot to stay in nyc!!

The apartment was fantastic, just what we needed, comfortable, homely and clean. Great location for the subway, 20 minutes to Manhattan. We enjoyed the area and some great recommendations of places to eat/drink. We asked for some advice on getting back to the airport and Guillermo happily booked us a car service which was very helpful. Fantastic host and a lovely apartment. Very enjoyable stay.

We stayed in a lovely block in park slope very close to prospect Park. We know the area well and thelication was perfect, very close to f train stop on 7th Avenue. The accommodation is a very nice garden studio with all the amenities. Nick arranged for the keys to be available when we got there and was pretty helpful at checkout. Would love to stay there again

We had a great stay with mark at the beautiful brownstone. It was just as described, and he was very easy to get ahold of. Subway, restaurants and stores are all a short walk. Would definitely stay again.

I stayed here for 5 nights as I was working on 29th street for the week. My wife Carol was supposed to come with me but could not at the last minute. Mirabel's place was immaculate and well appointed with everything a traveler needs. It's location is handy to the 2 and 3 trains to take you downtown in 20 mins, 6 stops to Penn Station at 34th. And it is only 9 short blocks to Central Park. There is a supermarket 2 blocks away. In a crowded city this apartment was felt spacious and well lit. The bedding was super comfortable and lux. It felt like the Ritz! There is a reason Mirabel's place is booked months ahead. I'd definitely stay here again.

Arriving was smooth. A safe neighbourhood, mostly Asian families live in.
The apartment was not clean at all. However with the price you pay you should expect more.

Evelyn was great, met us after we checked in and gave us some tips for the neighborhood (along with the extensive book in the room) and was very nice/helpful. The room was cozy, plenty big for 2 people, was quiet and getting in and out was very easy.

My parents stayed with Anna for a week as I live in the neighborhood. She was wonderful and made them feel very welcome with snacks and supplies. When my mom hurt her foot Anna's husband drove her to the doctor and was very helpful

We very much enjoyed our stay in Judy's beautiful appartment. It was very clean, comfortable and spacious.
Judy was very helpful and gave us "Insider" tipps for our stay. We very much appreciated that she accommodated us on short notice (after our original host Ronnie cancelled on us 27 hours prior to our arrival in NY)

My boyfriend and I had a great stay at Bobby's place.  Close to the subway and good restaurants in the area.  The bed was extremely comfortable and it was warm in the apartment (our stay was in December).
Great apartment! Nice and clean, beds were comfortable, and Aswad was great! Would definitely stay there again, and would recommend this place to anyone visiting the city.

I enjoyed my three nights at Guillermo's place. It was clean and comfortable and had everything I needed to cook breakfast in the mornings. It was walking distance to the shopping hubs I was interested in visiting. Highly recommend.
Very nice place.  Good location.  The G train was down all weekend but the next closest station wasn't too far.  We loved the neighborhood.

This Harlem Location is PERFECT! Chito and Xavier’s place was quaint, nice and clean. Great for younger guest, but Baby-boomer age not so much. I only say that because of the very narrow spiral staircase that you’ve gotta maneuver from the below level bedroom if you’re in a hurry to use the restroom that’s upstairs!! AND it’s best to be in good shape and not overweight or exceptionally tall!!
Other than THAT PART, the host and apartment was great!!!
Comfortable and stylish suite in a quiet and friendly neighborhood. Virginia & Steve were hospitable and quick to respond to all our needs. Great place to stay, highly recommend!

We stayed at Judy’s place over the thanksgiving holiday and hosted thanksgiving dinner for 6 adults and 2 children while there.   The apartment is very comfortable, great bed, updated bathroom with great shower/tub and updated kitchen.   Located in a wonderful neighborhood in Brooklyn with easy access to lots of restaurants and shops.   And while the bedroom faces the street the windows were doubled for soundproof and we found it very quiet for New York.  We highly recommend the Judy’s place.
Aswad has created a very nice flat for travelers to Brooklyn.  Lot’s of attention to details; very clean, comfortable beds, lots of space to lounge. We would definitely stay again.

This was a great location for our primary reason for coming to NYC, which was to visit a relative at Mt. Sinai Hospital. In between hospital  visits, we went to Central Park and The Met. We walked everywhere-and the apt had a good amount of room for our family of 4. Definitely recommended!

As a 1st time Airbnb participant I didn’t know what to expect!
Flori’s place exceeded my expectations!
It was perfect in every detail!
Very clean and quiet place. Virginia and Steve are nice hosts that made our stay smooth and enjoyable in spite of unwelcoming weather. Highly recommend this apartment and service!
Clean and well-furnished; the walls are thin enough that you can hear your next door neighbors loud and clear.

Akem and Terry have a great place to rent for your time in the area. The price was great for the time we spent there. There is a small grocery and train station within walking distance for any travel or food needs. They answered any questions we had in a timely manner!
This place is in a great location. Good coffee shops and the train were all a short walk away. The host keep this place super tidy and were quick to respond to any messages.

Perfect stay, Aleksandar was quick to reply for any questions.
Check-in and check out very easy.
Thanks!
A nice small apartment.. private enterance, very clean smelled nice. a nice stay for the weekend

This was one of the best Airbnb experiences I have ever had. The room was spacious, clean, and well equipped. I felt so comfortable and at home. This Brooklyn neighborhood offers just about everything you're probably looking for in Manhattan, great food, great bars, unique shops, and unbeatable New York culture. If you are compelled to spend time in Manhattan (as I was), the C train is a 3 min walk away and can have you at  the W 42nd St. station in less than 30 min.  As far as the host goes, you will not find one more courteous, charming, or accommodating than Rob.  If you have the chance, chat him up.
Great location for those who want to explore Brooklyn and have easy and fast access to the city. The apartment is perfect for two people. Thank you!

I highly recommend Hugh's place.  Modern style, very spacious, very clean, great amenities, great layout and in a great location.  I can't repeat enough how much room it has.  It is a true 1 bedroom.  And of course Hugh was great.
Lynette’s place was really lovely and clean. We enjoyed our stay at her place and would recommend it to anyone who is looking a quiet place for a getaway.

Expertly hosted space! Anna accommodated my late check in due to my flight schedule, made sure there were beers in the fridge and sent a message checking in on me when the weather dropped below freezing suddenly. Would absolutely stay here again!

Wonderful former artists studio with lots of charm. Great location, clean, warm and a comfortable bed. Tabita is very responsive and helpful. Kitchen facilities are limited but fine for us as we did not cook.

I really didn’t like this place you had to be real quite or be charged a fee then there is no tv the host really freaked me out how she kept whispering when she talked to me very uncomfortable I sat in my truck most of the time to listen to music since their is no tv when my days were over I was very happy to leave felt like prison

The location is perfect for enjoying lower east side and soho area. While my first thing was to go Traderjoe's... And you can also get China town discount. If you are familiar with NYC old appartment, you would find nothing to complain as you can also use the roof top like your backyard. Autumn took care of my safe and convenient stay all the time. Everything perfect for me.

This place is in such a nice and quiet neighborhood, everything is very close by. The owner leaves out nice pamphlets for local food and places to sightsee nearby. Very clean and well kept and the extra amenities are a plus! 10/10

Inna's place was perfect for my needs, and responsiveness was absolutely perfect.  This is an ideal location on the UES -- close to travel, food, and fun.  The apartment feels spacious for a New York apartment, and the windows get plenty of sun.  Inna was a perfect host and responded immediately on the rare occasion when I had a question.  I would highly recommend this apartment!
Clean, comfortable, convenient, and a convivial Italian restaurant 20 yards away. What more could you want? Host is very attentive and helpful.
Renae’s place is very comfortable, cute and in a great location. Everything was as described on the Airbnb site and Renae was a good and timely communicator. Highly recommended.

Sara's place is absolutely perfect. My husband and I stayed here for close to two weeks and we couldn't have asked for a better place to stay. She's in a great location and the apartment has everything you need to be comfy. We had an issue figuring out the front door on our first night and she was kind enough to quickly come over and help us out - we felt like total idiots but she was so sweet about it. I definitely recommend staying here!

Jacqueline’s place is funky, old school but has everything you need. The bed is nice and firm. You can hear the birds in the cage next door but that’s kind of nice. Neighborhood is nice enough. I walked to park slope from there and it took me an hour. My only complaint is that when I arrived the gate was locked and I couldn’t get in and I didn’t get an answer back for three hours. Luckily enough I could meet up with my son during that time but it would have been very inconvenient otherwise after driving at least 6 hours and needing to use the restroom.
Lou’s apartment was perfect for our mini get together. Very clean and well kept. Lou was the perfect host. Responded almost immediately to all questions. Will definitely be booking with him again.

Chester's place was great! I worked from home some of the days and had no problem with the internet and finding everything I need. Chester was very communicative and a great host. Would love to stay again!

First let me say that Lou is an amazing host and is genuinely a great person.  The house is exactly as described and seen in the pictures. My guests loved it and also the fact that there was plenty of street parking.  I will definitely book it should the need arise again.

Our stay was amazing, such a great location. The place was super clean and had extra blankets and towels. Asaf was super helpful in finding the place and getting in. The self check in and self check out really eliminated some stress on us too. All around great experience, will book again!
great little getaway in a cozy location. could use some extra cleaning but you’ll probably be too busy exploring the city to care!
The description of this place is 100% accurate. Martha was always available to answer any questions or concerns during  my 1 month stay.
The stay was wonderful. We weren’t home that often, but any issues that we had were resolved quickly. Definitely recommend!!

Sandee's apartment is a quiet and charming oasis in a lovely Brooklyn neighborhood.   Everything was perfectly clean and comfortable, and convenient to many wonderful restaurants, bars, public transport, etc.     Sandee's communication was great and she provided thoughtful touches for us, and had basic kitchen items on hand which came in handy.   The apartment building is very quiet with absolutely zero street noise.   Highly recommend!

We couldn’t ask for a nicer place to stay. The host and accommodations are lovely, and the Carroll Gardens neighborhood is beautiful!  It was really easy to get to other parts of the city from there. We had such a great trip!
Lovely apartment, easy access to Manhattan and other sites and Michelle is a very responsive and helpful host! Highly recommend.
Future travelers should definitely book this place. It is located in a quiet neighborhood in Queens. Kevin and Mike are amazing host!! Very clean and cozy. 10/10

Will recommend this place to friends and family. Its location is close to LGA and to all tourist locations in NY. Apartment was super clean and easy to access. Great service from the host, preparing candle lights before our arrival visit. Will definitely come back!
A stone’s throw from the beach, short walk to bars, grocery store, restaurants. We slept 7 with no problem at all. We would definitely stay here again.
Was coming back to the area and needed convenient spot to stay. Location was as described and parking was easy on the street. Would stay here again.

Ron was an amazing host! Before we arrived, he was in contact making sure we knew how to get there and made checking in super easy. His place was clean and very put together (also the bed is so soft). He even left us a little welcome treat which isn’t something you see often at places like this. He was super communicative, making sure we were doing alright and everything was good with our stay. I highly recommend staying here!
If I could give 10 stars I would! Victor was a great host and his apartment was lovely. The pictures don't do it justice. He was very accommodating and welcoming. Would definitely stay here again!

Is important to know that it is a small room and consider this if you are expecting a normal sized one because it’s not like that. The place works perfectly fine if you are going to be mostly out from the room (which I think is the idea) the location of it couldn’t be more perfect, is literally a few steps away from the Empire State Building, subway, food stores, restaurants, etc. It worked perfectly for my friend and I.

Don't hesitate guys. You will LOVE Sergio's place. The room is huge, the bed is comfy, everything was clean and check-in was quicker than quick.
Sergio is the best, gives you all the help you need and is just lovely to talk to.
I really loved the location and that there is a metro station just 2 blocks away.
My top tip for the neighborhood would be really good mexican food in the brothers café, right up the street and if you don't mind a 12 min walk, go check out the mad café! Such a gem in sunnyside.
I'll be back :)

A gem in a great area of Brooklyn, close to great restaurants, neighborhood bars, Prospect Park and Metro stops. Everything we needed, very comfortable bed and furniture and extremely quiet at night. Susan is a great communicator and very responsive. One minor issue was resolved quickly and completely. Perfect for our visit and would definitely stay here again.
Best location, ride the train to time square, eat at very near by restaurants, beautiful home, warm neighborhood, lovely neighbors, clean clean clean clean! I learned better recycling!

SI House is a beautifully modern and sleek apartment; it looked exactly like it did in the pictures! The rain shower was heavenly, and the kitchen had all the necessary utensils. The only thing missing was a hanging wardrobe but I'm sure that's to come. The residential neighbourhood is pristine and peaceful, and I felt very safe. If you drive, this is an excellent option if you bounce between Staten Island and Brooklyn because of the close proximity to Verrazzano Bridge. There are lots of free street parking spaces. What stood out the most was Susanna's attention to detail and attentiveness. I would recommend this location!

This apartment is very small but the bed and bathroom are nice and clean and the location is excellent. The building itself was bizarrely laid out and the room numbers are confusing. The elevators were fast and responsive. The security was friendly. Would definitely stay again if I was in midtown

Perfect place for my boyfriend and I to stay during my visit to NYC. It was close to his neighborhood in Harlem and a short walk to a local grocery store, some restaurants and Broadway street. I arrived late in the evening and when I messaged him regarding parking he gave me his parking spot and sent me a link for a parking lot for future reference. The oven wasn’t working but Mindia offered to send someone to fix it immediately. The place was just as pictured and clean. Would love to stay here again if available. Great host!

Light and bright 2BR - super comfortable and open space - washer/dryer and dishwasher was a huge plus!  Unit is decorated super cute with lots of thoughtful amenities.  The host was very helpful and kind and it made for a nice stay in a Victorian neighborhood, walking distance to the subway.

If you're looking for a beautifully furnished, spacious apartment in a lively neighborhood off the beaten track this is the place you should stay. It's close to various bus lines that bring you deeper into the Bronx (if you want to explore the notorious borough a bit more) as well as only a 10 minute walk to the Yankee stadium subway station where the 4 and D trains take you easily and fast everywhere in Manhattan and further. Natalie and Pierre are amazing and accommodating hosts. Also the apartment is super clean. We had a great time!
great location and nice and clean air b and b. I would recommend this place 10/10 times.
The hosts were extremely responsive, friendly and the space was perfect. The bed and pillows were amazing. Thank you for hosting us!

Sandee’s place was fantastic we enjoyed everything about, the apartment was as described clean with everything you may need. Neighbourhood was beautiful and easy to walk to every thing. Our host had a well appointed book with all of the best recommendations in the area. Would definitely stay again, thanks Sandee.

We loved our stay in Harlem - great location, only 10 minutes walk from Central Park and 5 minutes from closest subway, taking you direct to the city.
The apartment was beautiful and light-filled - it felt like a retreat at the end of a day of site-seeing. Has a quintessential European feel with a terrace looking to the city skyline. It was an authentic, Harlem experience. Make sure to visit Sylvia’s Soul food around the corner.
Jamal is an amazing host. Very accommodating and helpful. We loved our stay and can’t wait to come back. House is beautiful and spotless had everything we needed and more. ☺️🫶🏽

Whenever visiting we will stay again !!
The host was responsive. We truly enjoyed our stay . This air bnb was perfect for us. If ever in. The NewYork area give this place a try you will not be disappointed.

Gloria place is a nice accommodation for a budget friendly visit to New york. Its clean with well stock kitchen as well as enough linens. This place only has one private room. The other rooms are pass through but it worked well for us.
Awesome brownstone house in a lovely, quiet neighborhood with an awesome host, Nehprii, always friendly, reacts very quickly. We had a great time. Thank you Nehprii!

I loved everything about this Airbnb. So cute and comfortable. Could not ask for a better location. Close to restaurants, supermarkets, Central Park, movie theaters, 24-hour pizza.  Ted and Diane were really nice. Also, I felt very safe in this neighborhood!

The location is great - very close the subway, restaurants, and grocery stores. The street is quiet. The studio was very clean when I arrived and Jay communicated very well during all my stay. The only bad thing is that it was pretty hot at some points during the summer. Overall it was a good stay.

Great place to stay for a city break. Host is teally friendly and helpful, with great suggestions.
Will certainly return.

Amazing space in the convenient location of East Village! The neighborhood was calm and quiet. The studio is in close proximity to lots of local great eats and drinks.
The space is equipped with the practical basics of an updated minimalistic apartment- bathroom and a full kitchen! Mohin's space is definitely a bang for your buck!
The studio is perfect for the short getaway in NYC without being in the center of Manhattan!

Great place to stay in New York, within walking distance to subway stations and shops. Studio is well furnished and quiet at night. Bathroom is functional, although the toilet would benefit from upgrading in the future. We enjoyed our stay.
Great location!  Very clean and just what we needed for my daughters and myself for a girls weekend getaway.  He was always very quick to respond!  Would stay here again!

Perfect place to stay while visiting relatives in the neighborhood.  The accommodations were private and spotless and the hosts were accessible and friendly.  There are several great restaurants that are walkable and a subway station a couple of blocks away.  Won't hesitate to stay here again when back in NYC.

Huge space ! - excellent location, safe and convenient for families. Beds are comfortable, 3.5 bathrooms! Sami is extremely communicative, very flexible and helpful with check out/check in as possible - the only issue was temperamental thermostat so apartment can run very hot or cold depending on the floor or time of day but many New York apartments seem to have this issue.
Great place. Great deal.  Definitely worth this day.   Public transportation is easily accessible from this location.

Jas was a great host! The place was clean, it had a full kitchen with a proper oven so we cooked many of our meals at home. The area is quite safe and close to all types of public transport, the bus stop is literally outside the house. Definitely recommend this place! 10/10 points.
Great location and has everything you need for a longer stay. Marina was very communicative and accommodating to my early arrival.
The place is as the pictures show. The location is excellent. We were allowed to make an early check in. All was great.
Stavro was very nice. The place is in a good location and had everything you need.

Great stay, simple and affordable
One thing - some rooms can get quite cold in the summer (65 degrees in my room during the day and colder at night) with the AC on, so you can (and should) ask for a space heater
I spent 7 nights there, it was exactly what I was looking for. Great place, decorated with care. All was perfect!

We were three adults in town for a film festival. We loved Ashley’s place! It was more spacious than we anticipated with a large lower level bedroom with double bed and a half bath and a roomy BR on the street level also with double bed. A third room had a single bed which we didn’t use. There was a full bath off the kitchen - everything was clean, functional and very attractively decorated. We were surprised to find that the large Dali print on the wall over the stairway was actually the TV!
Ashley sent us lots of information about dining, shopping, transportation and entertainment in the neighborhood.
Ashley’s place was close to the L train which goes through Williamsburg and into Manhattan - exactly the places we wanted to go.
Everything was so convenient. We would definitely return again!

The beds were comfortable, everything was neat, it was as needed in for a great time in NYC, really close to Union Square, pretty quiet.
The stove and oven worked great, the pots and pans were non stick and the spatulas were metal so they were scratched up. Though the internet connected and Haru reset it, it never worked very effectively, and phone data ended up being the way to go.
The building felt safe, the stairs coming up are slanted and a bit nerve wracking, but completely functional, and great for a stay in Union Square. Easy to get to, and easy to come in and out of.
Haru was kind, and didn't respond immediately, but always responded and made check out very easy.
Thank you!
We had a WONDERFUL stay--SUGGEST maybe a Air B N B book to give instructions on the Split heating-- But great location, as described, So many friendly persons in apt complex next door we met--

My wife and I really enjoyed your place to stay a week in Queens. Flexible check-in, felt right at home, clear instructions, responsive host, easy to find and easy to get inside. The whole place was very clean. She listed amenities and services and local recommendations. The neighborhood was walkable, lots to do, peaceful, great restaurants and great shopping. 5 star rating.
Easy and great place to stay if you are looking for a quick trip at an affordable price. Only downside is that the AC was broken but it you could crack a window to offset the heat. Highly recommend.

Zhiqin is such a wonderful host. We had the perfect stay after a long day of exploring New York. This place had everything I needed to unwind and relax. The amenities were on point, and it offered a comfortable and welcoming atmosphere. It was just what I needed to recharge before heading out again. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a  cozy spot!
Lovely apartment! Felt right at home with everything I needed. Would stay here again - thanks so much!

Very charming, artistic space where the kitchen and bathroom were tightly and cleverly packed. Living room is a good size. Maria is a great host, very responsive. The roof area was quite lovely to  swing in the hammock or sit in a chair. Felt very safe, and the neighborhood has a lot of shops and restaurants. About a 10 minute walk to the subway.
I stayed with my dog and this place was perfect. Clean and tidy so I was very comfortable.

we had an AMAZING time at Dorian's place.  The area is lovely, great to explore, great pizza place and Indian restaurant t and friendly shops with some lovely breakfast places a 25 minute walk away. We were able to get to Manhatten easily in around 35-40 minutes using the train. Dorian went above and beyond by giving us great recommendations for food places and even took us to a fantastic jazz bar on our last night which was outstanding. Couldn't recommend it highly enough. Thank you Dorian, you were a lovely host.

We loved the location and the apartment was perfect. Everything was really clean. Check-in and check-out were super easy. The neighbors upstairs were a little noisy, but we expected that from the reviews that were previously posted. We had zero issues with the apartment and the neighborhood was nice and convenient. We would definitely stay here again in the future. Great job, Lisa!

Host, he really kind and reply my chat so fast and constantly. The place is nice but it a bit far from the city center but still convenient since close to bus stop by 2mins walk and 15mins walk for subway.and  since we stay here more than 1 people but the host can give only 1 key fob to open the building. So it might not suit for people who not stick together for all the times since DMR hav wan other key to open. But it really nice everyone go home the same time.

Awesome, is the good word. I'm French and my English is not very good so Rebekah was a very good host she helped me a lot. Your apartment was perfect for me and my family. It was very clean and look like pictures. The kitchen and bathroom are very functionally, the background was very appreciated for sunny breakfasts. The sofas-bed are good for few nights and bed very comfortable. The neighbourhood are like you said "a little bit dirty but very safe" but we was really enjoyed it. Keep going to offer a good service, thanks again. All the best.
Benjamin's family
Good stay. Very responsive and nice host, the apartment was clean and nice but a bit small and subway noise quite often.

My wife is a clean freak and she was impressed! Loved the patio and the shower was great pressure and hot! Every little touch was great, phone chargers on nightstand, comfortable bed, noise machine, treats, coffee, even umbrellas! Hope to visit and stay again.
My girlfriend and I had a wonderful time in Brooklyn, thanks to Liz! The place was really clean and next to the subway. We felt really comfortable and would recommend this place without reservations!

I had always wanted to experience Brooklyn and this was a great place in the "Bed-Stuy" area. It was easy walking distance to everything we needed, and the apartment was comfortable with a great kitchen for when we brought food to spend time relaxing. It wasn't far to catch subways when we ventured down to Coney Island or over to Manhattan. The hosts' suggestions were helpful and they were responsive whenever we needed anything. The cost made a week in New York affordable and staying there was great fun!

Eli is welcoming, available and ready to help, while remaining extremely discreet.
The apartment is very clean, the neighborhood is quiet and there's no noise at night.

The apartment is spacious, clean and comfortable.
The location is ,on a quiet, pretty, safe street with nice local shops and restaurants and not too far from the subway (20 minutes to Manhattan).
Michelle is a great husband was helpful when required but unobtrusive the rest of the time.
We left something important behind and Michelle went above and beyond to ensure it was returned to us.
All in all we had a fantastic stay.

Great location, AC worked well, WiFi worked well, had a microwave, small stove, and a large fridge! But bed wasn’t very comfy imo. But the worst part was having to lock the door and walk in a public hall to a shared bathroom in the middle of the night 😬

Ideal for anyone travelling on a budget.. location is best thing on this apartment! Apartment is over a bar, so this is definitely for someone with light sleeping, we did fine! We had an issue with WI-Fi, it did not work the whole stay... Besides that everything was good

This home suited our needs perfectly! We had a large crew and many children and we adored it! Hospitality was excellent! Cleanliness was excellent! Kindness, communication and graciousness was superb.  Great coffee in walking distance.  Subway not too far.  Very quiet neighborhood.  HIGHLY recommend.

The place was very nice. Comfortable beds and towels. Outside area was dirty and your average NYC. Only problem was that someone came in after our first night, mond you I only rented 2 nights, and shut off the A/C. Came back from a long and hot day to a super hot room. Room didnt cool to normal temp until the next day when we had to leave.

We love the area; room was clean and appeared as described on the website; host was responsive when I had questions.  Note that the room overlooks a courtyard that is the back of a restaurant so if you're sensitive to noise in the early morning hours (2 - 3 am), bring earplugs.  We're not sensitive so we were good.  Definitely recommend it considering the price - I did not see a better deal for something with a kitchenette and a private bath during this time period on Air BnB.

There are a few positive things to say. The area is very nice, clean and quiet. You are around a lot of places to eat from. Its overall a beautiful neighborhood. The airbnb itself is nice. The pictures are not up to date, but the place is nice. The bed is comfortable and so was the couch. The only issues I had was there were too many ants in the kitchen. I brought food from home to cook, but after I seen the ants i couldn’t do it. I’m not sure if it was heat in there because i didn’t see a thermometer and it was a cold rainy weekend so I had to suck it up I guess. I should’ve asked. Overall i had fun at this place and overall it was nice. I also loved the mirror in the room that was beautiful.

We stayed at Ashley’s place for a month. The place is spacious for 2. It is easy to get to the Subway. Yummy food near by. Quiet neighbors and Ashley was great at answering any questions we had during our stay. It is a nice place to stay that is far enough from Midtown for some quiet, but easy to hop on the 1 and be there in 25mins.

Loved staying here. Amazing location and super modern and stylish decor. The pros are: location, cleanliness, decor, great communication and super easy check in. As others have pointed out, the only considerations are the stairs (3rd floor walk-up with no elevator and old/dirty carpeting: when you first walk in, the stairs take you by surprise but when you get into the apartment, it’s “wow, this is so nice!”), and the street noise (the apartment is street facing and I’m a light sleeper so I had trouble sleeping - welcome to NYC! - if you’re a light sleeper like me turn on your white noise app or bring earplugs). Overall: I’d definitely stay there again and highly recommend it! Brinton was great and did a really nice job.

Andre's flat is very cosy, perfectly clean and in a quiet neighborhood. It is indeed a bit far from Manhattan but the subway station is very close and the express trains are running quite often. So if you're ok with 20 to 30 minutes by train, Andre's place is a perfect location. Andre is very helpful and always very quick to answer your question. It was very nice to find a lot of water in the fridge when we arrived.

This place was very stylish, had plenty of amenities to help accommodate my stay. Only thing i was disappointed about was the pressure of the sink was extremely low which harbored me being able to cook or utilize that sink at all during my stay. But everything else was great.
Annie was so sweet and was there whenever we needed her. Her and her husband helped us so much and made us feel so safe

Great place. Location is amazing. Outstandingly clean and sanitized due to COVID-19. The owner takes full caution ⚠️ to the virus. Me and my boyfriend book here all the time. You won’t regret it. Please book❤️❤️❤️💞💞

Perfect home , perfect area, perfect neighbors , and perfect host! Everything was super easy as far as checking in and checking out. Hospitality was awesome Alex texted to make sure everything was going well and if I needed anything. Would definitely recommend this place

Our stay was absolutely wonderful! The apartment was super cute, well appointed and clean. Wendy was a great host, comunicated well and was very responsive. We felt right at home. The neighborhood was quiet and just a short walk from the neighborhood stores and restaurants. I think we found our “go to” place for our future Brooklyn visits! Thanks Wendy!
A perfect location in Harlem! Not far from the subway with access to so much that the city has the offer!
Suliman was a great host.He provided place clean and tidy plus had all the aminities
Nice place exactly like the pictures. Good location and close to the subways! Would definitely stay here again.

The place is very near Korean town, train station and is easy to find. The room is smaller than I expected but you get what you paid for. They provided enough necessities and got some snacks too. The people during the stay were nice and quite. Three hosts are very responsive and one of them also be there during your stay if you need help. Highly recommended! :)

Evert has a beautiful home and we enjoyed our stay but there needs to be televisions in the bedrooms especially for down time. Wifi needs to be updated. It worked the first day we got there and would not reconnect even though we put in the password several times. I did reach out to Evert about the problem and he did not respond so we used our cellphone Hotspot for the Television in the Livingroom.
Great place to stay in NYC.  Extra nice having baggage hold before and after checkout and lounge to use.  Good AC as well.  Will stay again

Space is staged well, but dissapointing and not safe. Lock is clumsy and flimsy. Had city official and their representative in our space without us available. Obvious repairs needed, and dirty.  Zip ties to lock windows, hand prints on ceiling. Rusty, moldy bathroom. Faucet didn’t work well. Stunk horrible. Bed and floor collapsing.

Its a really neat and clean apartment, check in was seamless and convenient to leave your luggage after check out if your flight is still awhile later. Location was perfect too, short walk to Times Square, and many restaurants and eateries to check out in the vicinity. Shower heads might need an upgrade though, but all in all, my gf and I had a great stay! :)

Excellent stay. Ayanna was friendly, helpful, and responds quickly. The place is modern, and clean. Conveniently close to the subway, and transportation is easy. I really loved the roof deck. Great Brooklyn vibe.

Overall it was a nice apartment for our big family. The location was ok. But there is a lot to do for the host. A lot of stuff was broken and it was not as clean as we hoped.  The Dishwasher was very old and dirty, the towels were smelling and there were mouses in the kitchen. Only Something for animal lovers. The apartment is located in Brooklyn Bushwick. Its a five minute walk to the next subway station and a 30-40 minutes ride to mid-town Manhatten.

Thank you Barbi for providing the great place for us. We had a spectacular time there. The place comes with a bedroom, kitchen bathroom, and living room. Everything is private. The place is close to the subway line 2 and 3. It is very convenient to go to anywhere in the city. Barbi is a very, sweet, warm and friendly host. She lives downstairs and responded every request we had. She also teaches us how to do recycling in NYC with patience.
We cannot think of many improvements as the place is almost perfect. One tiny thing is just the ACs are loud and we didn’t find the heat, but it’s ok for September.
Excellent location, shops, restaurants, cafes within walking distance. Very safe area. Quiet apartment, can't hear neighbors.

Vanessa has been more than simply an Airbnb host, she's been welcoming and treated me like a friend. She has always been willing to help and give suggestions and tried her best to make me feel at home. The house itself is spacious and cozy, both for the room and the shared spaces, and is located in a safe and quiet neighbourhood. There are easy and frequent connections to Queens, other parts of Brooklyn, and to Manhattan, and the metro stops are just ten/fifteen minutes on foot from the house. I would definitely recommend this accomodation.

Love Hamilton Hieghts! Everything about the trip went smoothly and there were no complications. On a map it may look far from lower Manhatten but the subway way is more than sufficient. Would 10/10 recommend this location, it's super affordable, close to the subway and in a historical district and a nice quiet break after a full day in the city

David did not meet us in person. His neighbor helped us check in. David's loft is absolutely wonderful! Not far away from the subway and several excellent restaurants around the block. The building is next to the road so it's a little bit noisy at night.
Good location. But the room has a kitchenette and the smell from the sink is very strong it stinks of dampness

Great location in Manhattan, but this unit had some serious cleanliness issues— hair in the bed, dead bug in the bathtub, grime on the floor. And the mattresses were very uncomfortable! We all awoke every morning with a backache. I have stayed with this group before, but this was not their best.
Good for a short stay. Could be cleaner but not bad if you’re just there 1-2 nights. Host was nice and accommodating.

For the price, this location was perfect. The bed was super comfortable and clean. The bathroom was clean and the host was super responsive with providing more towels upon request. The room is a good size for one traveler or a couple. It is noisy but thats NYC for you! Would definitely come back 😊

I would 100% recommend staying here. Excellent location, close to lots of great stuff and the subway. Laundry just next door, and Jhovana has thought of EVERYTHING, from extra towels to earplugs- not to mention having great recommendations for what to do in the area. Really great stay.
The place was not described as how it was cameras inside no privacy and didn’t smell right it was uncomfortable do not recommend this Airbnb.

Overall this place was what we expected. It is very close to the A train but it does take at least 45 minutes on that train to get to midtown. It was comfortable and clean. Rashid was very responsive and a great host.
The ceilings are low as the listing says but we knew this ahead of time so it didn’t bother us. For reference we are both 5ft4in and would hit the ceiling with our hands while doing things like putting hair in a ponytail.
The only negative was that the wifi was so slow it was unusable. However we didn’t ask Rashid if it could be fixed so it might have been a temporary issue.
Overall we were comfortable and would consider booking this place again.
Karen's place was very comfortable and in a great location.  Not a far walk to the subway and lots of restaurants nearby.  The room was as described - clean & comfortable.  Will definitely come back.

We were very happy with our stay in this apartment overall! Cute neighborhood and very close to the subway station! The only thing worth mentioning is that the apartment was not suitable for 3 adults. The pull-out sofa bed was extremely uncomfortable and you would wake up with back pain. Maybe its ok if you're staying one or two nights but we stayed for 9 nights...
Other than that we loved it and would definitely come back! Just not all three of us haha...

The room was very small but not unexpected. I slept well (bring earplugs, it's NYC!) and was off in the morning back in the late afternoon for a nap and shower and out again for dinner and NY stuff. If another guess is staying there bathroom time requires patience and respect (the bathroom is small and cramped too, but like the bedroom functional. Lola is a great host: friendly , good communicator, and was respectful of  privacy. The place is what it is, affordable, and two thumbs up for Lola!

Aloha ,
Taking my island born wife to NYC was made simple and easy staying at Yoels in Brooklyn.
We were absolutely delighted with the location & the actual space was Very clean, beachy & Very Cute!
Our hosts were absolutely charming & incredibly helpful with local recommendations.
We will be staying there again soon on our next trip to the City!!!
Aloha & Mahalo Plenty 🤙🏽🤙🏽
Sincerely
Michael & Jeannine

Did not enjoy my stay.
No parking available on site despite being advertised and it caused me to spent 160+USD to park in a lot. Unreliable street parking that has black out hours each day. Could not get anything reliable and felt my car was unsafe. Parking was the reason I chose this place and felt I was mislead unlike other properties in the area.
The entrance code change in the middle of my stay and I got locked out of the building at night!!!! I did not feel safe getting back into the building. New air bnb guests also burst in and tried to push past the doors when I tried leaving one morning.
Space was too small for four people. No cleaning supplies and excessive rules. Was not able to access to garbage area as directed within the end of stay instructions.
The place was not as advertised and I am very unhappy with my stay.
